query: SELECT name AS "name!: String", status_type AS "status_type!: String", is_starting AS "is_starting!: i64", is_terminal AS "is_terminal!: i64" FROM issue_states ORDER BY CASE status_type WHEN 'backlog' THEN 0 WHEN 'unstarted' THEN 1 WHEN 'started' THEN 2 WHEN 'completed' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, name
